claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'species_trait' kind. SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, and MasteryRecord are the only variants. A SpeciesTraitRecord is required before any species trait mechanics can be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Kind: species_trait (from task specification and TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §1 which lists 'species_trait_root' as a source atom without a corresponding TypeScript record)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cone and line shapes in Attachment area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Breath Weapon fires in either a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line (5 ft wide). The current Attachment area shape only supports 'sphere'. Cone and Line are distinct geometric shapes with different SRD rules.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide

claude_proposed_widenings.name: proficiency_bonus-scaled UseCountCap
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Breath Weapon uses are equal to the character's Proficiency Bonus. UseCountCap only supports 'fixed' and 'threshold_tiers'. A PB-derived cap is a recurring SRD 5.2.1 pattern (multiple species traits, some class features) that cannot be expressed with the current variants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus

claude_proposed_widenings.name: half_damage save result in Effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a successful Dexterity save the target takes half damage. This is not expressible as a DiceAmount (no half-of-roll expression exists) and is semantically distinct from a fixed reduced DiceExpr. Half-damage on save is a fundamental SRD damage pattern appearing on dozens of area spells and features.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability-specific DcSource for species traits
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Breath Weapon DC is 8 + CON modifier + PB. The existing 'weapon_attack_dc' kind says 'attack ability mod' without specifying which ability, making it semantically incorrect for a CON-based species-trait DC. A named-ability DC source variant would correctly capture this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus
